purpose: Phase-5B.1 SIGNALING PATHWAY-PROFILE registry. A pathway profile binds exactly one context (from signal-context.registry.json) to a set of node ids (signal-nodes) and edge ids (signal-edges), plus start/stop conditions and an evidence/uncertainty summary. ARCHITECTURE + EVIDENCE ONLY. No runtime propagation. Profiles never mix species or cell models. Accept/reject/defer decisions are recorded here.

5B-H1.title: Human HaCaT - oxidative-stress / Nrf2-ARE cytoprotective signaling (exposure-driven prediction)
5B-H1.stop_condition: HO-1 signaling-output state reached (no protein synthesis / expression modelled)
5B-H1.evidence_summary: Canonical intracellular relationships (ROS->MAPK, MAPK->Nrf2, Nrf2->ARE) are EXPERIMENTAL_PATHWAY_SPECIFIC (established general biology). The exposure->ROS entry and ARE->HO-1 output are LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION for celastrol in HaCaT. Nothing is EXPERIMENTAL_FORMULATION_SPECIFIC; the frozen Profile-B package reports NO signaling.
5B-H1.uncertainty_summary: Entire cascade is a prediction: the frozen package measured only cellular uptake in HaCaT. Directionality follows canonical biology; magnitudes/timings are NOT_REPORTED. Requires primary-source verification before any Phase-5B.2 upgrade.
5B-H1.accept_rationale: Coherent, well-established oxidative-stress cytoprotective axis with a clear exposure-driven start and a schematic signaling-output stop; every claim is labelled at or below its true evidence tier.

5B-H2.title: Human HaCaT - NF-κB suppression / anti-inflammatory signaling (exposure-driven prediction)
5B-H2.stop_condition: inflammatory signaling-output state reduced (no cytokine/protein production modelled)
5B-H2.evidence_summary: Exposure->NF-κB inhibition is LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION (celastrol NF-κB suppression widely described, not in frozen package). NF-κB->inflammatory-output is EXPERIMENTAL_PATHWAY_SPECIFIC (canonical). Baseline NF-κB is active; the drug edge is inhibitory.
5B-H2.uncertainty_summary: Suppression represented as a signaling-state change only. No cytokine, ICAM, or protein-expression endpoint is modelled. Requires primary-source verification.
5B-H2.accept_rationale: Distinct, non-overlapping axis from 5B-H1 (inhibitory, baseline-active), same context, cleanly labelled; supports representing both activation and inhibition semantics in one context without mixing cell models.

5B-M1.title: Mouse B16BL6 melanoma - PI3K/AKT/mTOR survival-signaling suppression (exposure-driven prediction)
5B-M1.stop_condition: survival signaling-output state reduced (no apoptosis / tumour endpoint modelled)
5B-M1.evidence_summary: Exposure->PI3K inhibition is LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION (celastrol in B16BL6 not in frozen package). PI3K->AKT->mTOR->survival-output are EXPERIMENTAL_PATHWAY_SPECIFIC (canonical). Baseline pathway active; drug edge is inhibitory upstream, attenuating the canonical activating chain.
5B-M1.uncertainty_summary: Mouse melanoma cascade is predicted; frozen package measured only uptake/cytotoxicity in B16BL6, not the signaling steps. No human pathway is reused for mouse. Requires primary-source verification.
5B-M1.accept_rationale: Establishes a second SPECIES (mouse) and disease context (melanoma) with an independent survival-signaling axis, exercising the no-silent-transfer rule; cleanly labelled and DAG-shaped.

5B-R1.title: Rat skin - signal transduction NOT REPORTED
5B-R1.evidence_summary: No rat cellular signaling evidence exists. Chen 2012 used rat only for ex-vivo skin permeation. Signal transduction is NOT REPORTED for rat.
5B-R1.uncertainty_summary: An empty profile is the correct honest state; no human/mouse pathway is silently transferred to rat.
5B-R1.reject_or_defer_rationale: NOT_REPORTED (not rejected on merit, simply no evidence and no valid predictive basis without a cellular model).

5B-H3.title: Human HaCaT - additional celastrol axis (e.g. HSF1/HSP or JNK stress branch)
5B-H3.defer_rationale: A third human axis was considered but DEFERRED for Phase 5B.1: it would overlap/crosstalk with 5B-H1 (shared ROS/stress input) and asserting the crosstalk edges now would exceed the evidence available in the repo. Feedback/crosstalk is NOT_REPORTED in 5B.1; this profile is revisited only if primary-source evidence is attached and a typed crosstalk representation is designed.

accept_reject_defer_log.basis: Coherent Nrf2-ARE cytoprotective axis, cleanly tiered evidence.
Distinct inhibitory NF-κB axis, same context, exercises inhibition semantics.
Second species/disease survival axis, exercises no-silent-transfer.
Would require crosstalk edges beyond available evidence; feedback/crosstalk NOT_REPORTED in 5B.1.
No rat cellular signaling evidence; empty profile is the honest state.
